messages:
Sam (PM): quick sync — we need to lock DP sampling cadence + exact engineering resource commitments for the upcoming private preview. Goal: ensure feedback loops surface actionable signals pre/post launch. Proposed: 50 active seats, staggered invites, weekly 10-min pulse + monthly 1:1s. thoughts?
Mira (Eng): 50 is pretty large for initial private preview. i'd do 15-25 to start. engineering ask: ~0.2 FTE per active DP during onboarding week for triage/integration.
Jesse (ProdOps): ops can support 25. provisioning + billing automation ~2 days per cohort. recommend stagger invites by ~5/day to avoid provisioning spikes.
Lena (Research): for pulse: short weekly micro-survey + automated evals. signal set = NPS-like satisfaction, failure rate on canonical prompts, latency regressions. suggest 3 auto-evals/week on the canonical prompt set. template (quick):
```
pulse_survey:
  q1: how useful was the model today?
  q2: did you hit any regressions?
  q3: any blocking issues (y/n)?
```
Rahul (Sales): customers want an escalation path for model-change blockers; ask for SLA: response within 48h for critical regressions. also discuss DP compensation — $500 credit vs dedicated workshop? what's preferred.
Sam (PM): agree on 48h escalation for critical. launch gates (proposal): 1) latency within SLO on canary, 2) >=80% pass rate on eval set, 3) median satisfaction >=4/5 from DP pulse. ok?
Mira (Eng): latency SLO check = straightforward via canary. quality pass needs baseline harness + 2-day tuning window. if we can't hit quality gate, fallback to narrower model config.
Jesse (ProdOps): ops ask: 1 eng on-call for first 2 weeks post-launch + 1 prodops lead for coordination. we'll own provisioning checklist.
Lena (Research): feedback loop deliverables: weekly digest (top 5 issues), shared doc with triage status, and prioritized action items. we should tag high-priority items with label `dp-urgent`.
Sam (PM): two concrete asks before i freeze: 1) finalize compensation language for outreach, 2) confirm eng runway in FTE-days.
Rahul (Sales): i'll draft outreach + compensation options today. leaning toward credits + 60-min product deep-dive as standard. i'll share the template.
Mira (Eng): we can commit to 1.0 eng-days per DP for onboarding (initial week) and 0.2 eng-days/week for maintenance for first 8 weeks. scaling past 25 will require an extra eng headcount or rotating on-call.
Jesse (ProdOps): i'll add a provisioning checklist to the repo and schedule a dry-run/cutover next tues. will include billing automation steps and seat revocation process.
OpsBot: reminder — stub runbook created at /docs/dp-runbooks/sample-runbook.md. please populate with playbook steps and incident contacts.
Sam (PM): :thumbsup: thanks — unless anyone objects i'll freeze the gates + runbook by EOD tomorrow. ping me with any showstoppers.
